Copy this page's structure when adding a protocol. A good protocol can be followed without asking the author.

## Overview

One paragraph: what this protocol produces and when to use it.

## Materials / Requirements

- Reagents, kits, software, or accounts needed
- Approximate time required

## Steps

1. Numbered, unambiguous steps.
2. Note critical steps and common failure points inline.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| ... | ... | ... |

## References

Link the source paper, kit manual, or original protocol if adapted.
